+package main
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
+	"net"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"runtime"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestHTTPService(t *testing.T) {
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(newHandler(core{t.TempDir()}, "tok", 1<<20))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	do := func(method, path, body, token, accept string) (int, string, http.Header) {
+		req, _ := http.NewRequest(method, srv.URL+path, strings.NewReader(body))
+		if token != "" {
+			req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
+		}
+		if accept != "" {
+			req.Header.Set("Accept", accept)
+		}
+		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		defer resp.Body.Close()
+		data, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
+		return resp.StatusCode, string(data), resp.Header
+	}
+	log := "2026-10-18T08:00:00Z INFO up\n2026-10-18T08:00:01Z ERROR disk full\n"
+
+	if code, body, _ := do("GET", "/healthz", "", "", ""); code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, `"status": "ok"`) {
+		t.Fatalf("healthz without a token: %d %s", code, body)
+	}
+	for _, tok := range []string{"", "wrong"} {
+		if code, _, h := do("POST", "/reduce", log, tok, ""); code != 401 || h.Get("WWW-Authenticate") == "" {
+			t.Fatalf("token %q: %d", tok, code)
+		}
+	}
+	code, body, _ := do("POST", "/reduce?budget=600", log, "tok", "")
+	var v map[string]any
+	if code != 200 || json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &v) != nil || v["format"] != "logs" {
+		t.Fatalf("reduce: %d %s", code, body)
+	}
+	ref := v["ref"].(string)
+	if code, body, _ := do("POST", "/reduce", log, "tok", "text/plain"); code != 200 || !strings.HasPrefix(body, "[abbreviatory] log") {
+		t.Fatalf("text: %d %s", code, body)
+	}
+	if code, body, _ := do("GET", "/expand/"+ref+":L2", "", "tok", ""); code != 200 || body != "2026-10-18T08:00:01Z ERROR disk full\n" {
+		t.Fatalf("expand: %d %q", code, body)
+	}
+	for _, c := range []struct {
+		method, path, body string
+		want               int
+	}{
+		{"GET", "/expand/nonsense", "", 400},
+		{"GET", "/expand/" + ref + ":L99", "", 400},
+		{"GET", "/expand/0123456789ab:g0", "", 404},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?budget=5", log, 400},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?budget=five", log, 400},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?format=yaml", log, 400},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?keep=(", log, 400},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?full=maybe", log, 400},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?format=json", `{"a": [1,`, 422},
+		{"POST", "/reduce", string([]byte{0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 0, 0}), 422},
+		{"POST", "/reduce", strings.Repeat("x\n", 600000), 413},
+		{"GET", "/runs/nothing-here", "", 404},
+		{"GET", "/reduce", "", 405},
+		{"DELETE", "/runs", "", 405},
+	} {
+		if code, body, _ := do(c.method, c.path, c.body, "tok", ""); code != c.want || !strings.Contains(body, "error") && code != 405 {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: %d, want %d: %s", c.method, c.path, code, c.want, body)
+		}
+	}
+	// Histories, with a key that has slashes and spaces.
+	key := "/home/me/app: go test ./..."
+	q := "/reduce?key=" + strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(key, " ", "%20"), "/", "%2F")
+	do("POST", q, log, "tok", "")
+	code, body, _ = do("POST", q, log, "tok", "")
+	if code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, `"run": 2`) {
+		t.Fatalf("second run: %d %s", code, body)
+	}
+	if code, body, _ := do("GET", "/runs/%2Fhome%2Fme%2Fapp:%20go%20test%20.%2F...", "", "tok", "text/plain"); code != 200 || !strings.HasPrefix(body, key+"\nrun 2") {
+		t.Fatalf("runs by key: %d %s", code, body)
+	}
+	if code, body, _ := do("GET", "/runs/me/app", "", "tok", ""); code != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, `"key": "/home/me/app: go test ./..."`) {
+		t.Fatalf("runs by part of the key: %d %s", code, body)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestHTTPNoToken(t *testing.T) {
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(newHandler(core{t.TempDir()}, "", 1<<20))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	resp, err := http.Post(srv.URL+"/reduce", "text/plain", strings.NewReader("x ERROR one\n"))
+	if err != nil || resp.StatusCode != 200 {
+		t.Fatalf("without a token configured: %v %v", err, resp.StatusCode)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestServeAddress(t *testing.T) {
+	for addr, want := range map[string]bool{"127.0.0.1:1": true, "localhost:1": true, "[::1]:1": true, "0.0.0.0:1": false, ":7878": false, "10.0.0.5:1": false, "nonsense": false} {
+		if isLoopback(addr) != want {
+			t.Errorf("isLoopback(%q) = %v", addr, !want)
+		}
+	}
+	_, errs, code := runCLI(t, "", "serve", "-addr", "0.0.0.0:0", "-store", t.TempDir())
+	if code != 2 || !strings.Contains(errs, "set -token") {
+		t.Fatalf("serving everywhere without a token: exit %d %s", code, errs)
+	}
+	_, errs, code = runCLI(t, "", "serve", "-max-body", "lots")
+	if code != 2 || !strings.Contains(errs, "-max-body") {
+		t.Fatalf("bad -max-body: exit %d %s", code, errs)
+	}
+}
+
+// serve stops cleanly on a signal; started as a real process.
+func TestServeProcess(t *testing.T) {
+	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" || testing.Short() {
+		t.Skip("needs a built binary and signals")
+	}
+	bin := buildBinary(t)
+	cmd := execCommand(bin, "serve", "-addr", "127.0.0.1:0", "-store", t.TempDir())
+	stderr, _ := cmd.StderrPipe()
+	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	buf := make([]byte, 200)
+	n, _ := stderr.Read(buf)
+	line := string(buf[:n])
+	i := strings.Index(line, "http://")
+	if i < 0 {
+		cmd.Process.Kill()
+		t.Fatalf("no address in %q", line)
+	}
+	url := strings.TrimSpace(line[i:])
+	resp, err := http.Get(url + "/healthz")
+	if err != nil || resp.StatusCode != 200 {
+		cmd.Process.Kill()
+		t.Fatalf("healthz: %v", err)
+	}
+	cmd.Process.Signal(stopSignals[1])
+	done := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() { done <- cmd.Wait() }()
+	select {
+	case <-done:
+		if code := cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode(); code != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("exit %d after a signal", code)
+		}
+	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
+		cmd.Process.Kill()
+		t.Fatal("serve didn't stop on a signal")
+	}
+}
+
+// Review of 0.3: without a token the service answers this machine only,
+// and not web pages: no other host names (DNS rebinding), no foreign
+// Origin (cross-site requests).
+func TestHTTPLocalOnly(t *testing.T) {
+	h := newHandler(core{t.TempDir()}, "", 1<<20)
+	do := func(method, target, host, origin string) (int, string) {
+		req := httptest.NewRequest(method, target, strings.NewReader("x ERROR secret password=hunter2\n"))
+		req.Host = host
+		if origin != "" {
+			req.Header.Set("Origin", origin)
+		}
+		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
+		h.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
+		return rec.Code, rec.Body.String()
+	}
+	for _, c := range []struct {
+		method, target, host, origin string
+		want                         int
+	}{
+		{"POST", "/reduce?key=proj", "localhost:7878", "", 200},
+		{"POST", "/reduce", "127.0.0.1:7878", "", 200},
+		{"POST", "/reduce", "[::1]:7878", "", 200},
+		{"POST", "/reduce", "localhost:7878", "http://localhost:3000", 200},
+		{"GET", "/runs", "attacker.example:7878", "", 403},
+		{"GET", "/runs", "attacker.example", "", 403},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?key=proj", "localhost:7878", "http://evil.example", 403},
+		{"POST", "/reduce?key=proj", "localhost:7878", "null", 403},
+		{"GET", "/healthz", "evil.example", "", 403},
+	} {
+		if code, body := do(c.method, c.target, c.host, c.origin); code != c.want {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s Host %s Origin %q: %d, want %d: %s", c.method, c.target, c.host, c.origin, code, c.want, body)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestHTTPDetails(t *testing.T) {
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(newHandler(core{t.TempDir()}, "tok", 1<<30))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	get := func(method, path, auth string, body io.Reader) (int, string, string) {
+		req, _ := http.NewRequest(method, srv.URL+path, body)
+		if auth != "" {
+			req.Header.Set("Authorization", auth)
+		}
+		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		defer resp.Body.Close()
+		data, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
+		return resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), string(data)
+	}
+	for _, auth := range []string{"Bearer tok", "bearer tok", "BEARER  tok"} {
+		if code, _, _ := get("GET", "/runs", auth, nil); code != 200 {
+			t.Errorf("%q: %d", auth, code)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, auth := range []string{"Bearer", "Basic tok", "Bearer tokx", "tok"} {
+		if code, _, _ := get("GET", "/runs", auth, nil); code != 401 {
+			t.Errorf("%q: %d, want 401", auth, code)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range []struct {
+		method, path string
+		want         int
+	}{{"GET", "/nothing", 404}, {"GET", "/reduce", 405}, {"DELETE", "/runs", 405}} {
+		code, ct, body := get(c.method, c.path, "Bearer tok", nil)
+		if code != c.want || !strings.HasPrefix(ct, "application/json") || !strings.Contains(body, `"error"`) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: %d %s %s", c.method, c.path, code, ct, body)
+		}
+	}
+	// /runs/ with nothing after it is the list.
+	if code, _, body := get("GET", "/runs/", "Bearer tok", nil); code != 200 || !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(body), "[") {
+		t.Errorf("/runs/: %d %s", code, body)
+	}
+	// A large original expands, streamed.
+	big := strings.Repeat("2026-10-18T08:00:00Z INFO tick 12345\n", 200000) + "x ERROR end\n"
+	code, _, body := get("POST", "/reduce", "Bearer tok", strings.NewReader(big))
+	var v map[string]any
+	if code != 200 || json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &v) != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("reduce: %d", code)
+	}
+	code, ct, whole := get("GET", "/expand/"+v["ref"].(string), "Bearer tok", nil)
+	if code != 200 || ct != "application/octet-stream" || whole != big {
+		t.Fatalf("whole expand: %d %s, %d bytes of %d", code, ct, len(whole), len(big))
+	}
+	code, _, part := get("GET", "/expand/"+v["ref"].(string)+":L200001", "Bearer tok", nil)
+	if code != 200 || part != "x ERROR end\n" {
+		t.Fatalf("last line: %d %q", code, part)
+	}
+}
+
+// Review of 0.3, second pass: slow uploads hold up nobody, and a JSON
+// pointer reference expands with its slashes as they are.
+func TestHTTPSlowUploadsAndPointers(t *testing.T) {
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(newHandler(core{t.TempDir()}, "", 1<<20))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	host := strings.TrimPrefix(srv.URL, "http://")
+	for i := 0; i < runtime.NumCPU()+2; i++ {
+		conn, err := net.Dial("tcp", host)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		defer conn.Close()
+		io.WriteString(conn, "POST /reduce HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: "+host+"\r\nContent-Length: 1000000\r\n\r\n0123456789")
+	}
+	time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
+	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
+	resp, err := client.Post(srv.URL+"/reduce?format=json", "application/octet-stream", strings.NewReader(`{"items": [{"id": 1, "error": "boom"}]}`))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("held up by slow uploads: %v", err)
+	}
+	var v map[string]any
+	json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&v)
+	resp.Body.Close()
+	ref, _ := v["ref"].(string)
+	for _, path := range []string{"/expand/" + ref + ":/items/0/error", "/expand/" + ref + ":%2Fitems%2F0%2Ferror"} {
+		resp, err := client.Get(srv.URL + path)
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
+		resp.Body.Close()
+		if resp.StatusCode != 200 || string(body) != "\"boom\"\n" {
+			t.Fatalf("%s: %d %q", path, resp.StatusCode, body)
+		}
+	}
+}

+<script src="wasm_exec.js"></script>
+<script>
+"use strict";
+const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
+const samples = {};
+let ready = false;
+
+function fmtBytes(n) {
+  if (n < 1000) return n + " B";
+  if (n < 1e6) return (n / 1000).toFixed(1) + " kB";
+  return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1) + " MB";
+}
+function group3(n) { return n.toLocaleString("en-US"); }
+function esc(s) { return s.replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c])); }
+
+async function loadSample(name) {
+  if (!name) return "";
+  if (!samples[name]) {
+    const r = await fetch("samples/" + name);
+    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("couldn't load the sample " + name);
+    samples[name] = await r.text();
+  }
+  return samples[name];
+}
+
+function showInput(text) {
+  $("input").value = text;
+  updateInStats();
+}
+function updateInStats() {
+  const t = $("input").value;
+  const lines = t ? t.split("\n").length - (t.endsWith("\n") ? 1 : 0) : 0;
+  $("inStats").textContent = t ? group3(lines) + " lines, " + fmtBytes(new TextEncoder().encode(t).length) : "";
+}
+
+// The report as HTML: references become buttons, sections get colour.
+function renderReport(text) {
+  const refRe = /\[ref ([0-9a-f]{12})(?::([^\]]+))?\]|(, ref )([0-9a-f]{12})|("ref": ")([0-9a-f]{12}:[^"]+)(")/g;
+  return text.split("\n").map((line) => {
+    let cls = "";
+    if (/^(FAILED|ERRORS)\b/.test(line)) cls = "l-fail";
+    else if (/^WARNINGS\b/.test(line)) cls = "l-warn";
+    else if (/^run \d+/.test(line)) cls = "l-delta";
+    else if (/^new: /.test(line)) cls = "l-new";
+    else if (/^(fixed|gone): /.test(line)) cls = "l-fixed";
+    let out = "", last = 0, m;
+    refRe.lastIndex = 0;
+    while ((m = refRe.exec(line))) {
+      out += esc(line.slice(last, m.index));
+      if (m[1]) {
+        const ref = m[1] + (m[2] ? ":" + m[2] : "");
+        out += '<button class="ref" data-ref="' + esc(ref) + '">' + esc(m[0]) + "</button>";
+      } else if (m[4]) {
+        out += esc(m[3]) + '<button class="ref" data-ref="' + m[4] + '">' + m[4] + "</button>";
+      } else {
+        out += esc(m[5]) + '<button class="ref" data-ref="' + esc(m[6]) + '">' + esc(m[6]) + "</button>" + esc(m[7]);
+      }
+      last = m.index + m[0].length;
+    }
+    out += esc(line.slice(last));
+    return cls ? '<span class="' + cls + '">' + out + "</span>" : out;
+  }).join("\n");
+}
+
+function reduceText(text, extra) {
+  const opts = Object.assign({ budget: +$("budget").value, format: $("format").value }, extra || {});
+  const raw = abbreviatory.reduce(text, JSON.stringify(opts));
+  if (typeof raw !== "string") throw new Error(raw.error);
+  return JSON.parse(raw);
+}
+
+function show(res) {
+  $("out").innerHTML = renderReport(res.text);
+  const out = new TextEncoder().encode(res.text).length;
+  const pct = res.input_bytes ? (100 * out / res.input_bytes) : 0;
+  const chips = [
+    '<span class="chip big">' + fmtBytes(res.input_bytes) + " → " + fmtBytes(out) + "</span>",
+    '<span class="chip">' + (pct < 1 ? pct.toFixed(2) : pct < 10 ? pct.toFixed(1) : Math.round(pct)) + "% of the input</span>",
+    '<span class="chip">' + esc(res.format) + "</span>",
+    '<span class="chip">' + res.ms.toFixed(0) + " ms</span>",
+  ];
+  if (res.run) chips.push('<span class="chip">run ' + res.run + "</span>");
+  $("stats").innerHTML = chips.join("");
+  $("expanded").style.display = "none";
+}
+
+function fail(err) {
+  $("stats").innerHTML = "";
+  $("out").innerHTML = '<span class="err">' + esc(String(err.message || err)) + "</span>";
+}
+
+function go() {
+  try {
+    const text = $("input").value;
+    if (!text.trim()) { fail("Paste something to reduce first."); return; }
+    show(reduceText(text));
+  } catch (e) { fail(e); }
+}

+### serve
+
+`abbreviatory serve [-addr 127.0.0.1:7878] [-token T] [-store DIR] [-max-body 1GB]`
+serves the same work over HTTP. It listens on this machine only unless it has
+a token (`-token`, else `$ABBREVIATORY_TOKEN`); an address reachable from
+other machines without one is refused. With a token, every request but the
+health check needs `Authorization: Bearer T` (the word Bearer in any case).
+
+Without a token it also turns away what a web page open in the user's
+browser could send it, with 403: a request whose `Host` isn't `localhost`,
+`127.0.0.1` or `[::1]` (a page using DNS rebinding to reach the service), and
+a request with an `Origin` that isn't a page on this machine (a cross-site
+form or fetch that could read stored originals or write runs into a
+history).
+
+| Request | Answer |
+|---|---|
+| `POST /reduce` | The body is the input. Query parameters: `format`, `budget`, `preserve` (present and empty for nothing), `keep` (repeatable), `key`, `full`, `no_store`, and `command` and `exit` to record with the run. The answer is the JSON of `reduce -json`; with `Accept: text/plain` the report alone, warnings in `Abbreviatory-Warning` headers |
+| `GET /expand/{ref}` | The original bytes, as `application/octet-stream`; a JSON pointer's slashes may stay as they are |
+| `GET /runs` | The histories, as `history -json` lists them (or as text with `Accept: text/plain`) |
+| `GET /runs/{key}` | One history's runs; the key percent-encoded, a part of it matching one key works |
+| `GET /healthz` | `{"status": "ok", "version": "..."}` |
+
+Errors are `{"error": "..."}` with 400 (a bad option, reference or line
+range), 401 (no or a wrong token), 403 (see above), 404 (a reference not in
+the store, no history matching, or no such endpoint), 405, 413 (a body past
+`-max-body`), 422 (input it can't read: binary data, a JSON document that
+doesn't parse, a budget too small for this input) or 500. Expansions stream
+from the store, so memory doesn't grow with the original (a JSON pointer
+reads its document whole); a JSON pointer in a reference may keep its
+slashes or have them percent-encoded. A reduction reads its body to a
+temporary file first, then waits for a turn: at most as many reductions as
+the machine has CPUs (at least 2) run at once, and a slow upload holds up
+nobody. A request may take 30 minutes to send its body, and an idle
+connection is closed after 2 minutes. A SIGINT or SIGTERM stops
+the service, letting requests in progress finish for up to 30 seconds.
+
+### mcp
+
+`abbreviatory mcp [-store DIR]` is a Model Context Protocol server over
+standard input and output: JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line, protocol
+versions 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26 and 2024-11-05. It offers four tools; their
+results have the report (or the expansion, or the history) as text, and the
+JSON of the command line's `-json` as structured content.
+
+| Tool | Arguments |
+|---|---|
+| `reduce` | `text` or `path`; `key`; the options below |
+| `run` | `command` (an array, not run through a shell); `cwd`; `timeout_seconds` (default 600); `stdin`; `key` (default: the project directory and the command); `no_history`; the options below |
+| `expand` | `ref`; `max_bytes` (default 4 MB, up to 64 MB; a larger part is refused with a hint to expand a smaller one) |
+| `history` | `key`, or none for the list |
+
+The options are `format`, `budget`, `preserve`, `keep` (an array), `full` and
+`no_store`, as the flags. `run` starts the command in a process group of its
+own; at the time limit, when the client cancels the request
+(`notifications/cancelled`), or when the server stops (its input ends, or it
+gets SIGINT or SIGTERM), the group gets SIGTERM and, 5 seconds later,
+SIGKILL. A request the client cancelled gets no answer; one stopped because
+the server is stopping is answered with what the command printed. On Windows the command's process tree is ended with `taskkill /T`.
+A problem with the work (a command not found, binary output, a bad option)
+comes back as a result with `isError` set; an unknown tool or method is a
+protocol error, a batch or anything but a JSON object an invalid request,
+and a response from the client is ignored. Requests are answered as they
+finish, so a long `run` doesn't hold up others.
+
 ### history
 
 `abbreviatory history` lists the histories, most recent first. `abbreviatory

+// ExpandTo writes the part of an original that a selector names to w, as
+// Expand returns it, reading the original as a stream: memory doesn't grow
+// with the original, except for a JSON pointer or the errors of a JSON
+// document, which need the document whole. A bad selector is reported
+// before anything is written.
+func ExpandTo(w io.Writer, original io.Reader, ix *Index, sel string) error {
+	if sel == "" {
+		_, err := io.Copy(w, original)
+		return err
+	}
+	if !lineSel.MatchString(sel) && ix.Format == "json" && (sel == "errors" || strings.HasPrefix(sel, "/")) {
+		data, err := io.ReadAll(original)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		part, err := Expand(data, ix, sel)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		_, err = w.Write(part)
+		return err
+	}
+	rs, unit, err := selectRanges(ix, sel)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	bw := bufio.NewWriterSize(w, 64<<10)
+	br := bufio.NewReaderSize(original, 64<<10)
+	if unit == "bytes" {
+		var pos int64
+		for _, r := range rs {
+			if r.Start < pos || r.End < r.Start {
+				continue
+			}
+			if _, err := io.CopyN(io.Discard, br, r.Start-pos); err != nil {
+				break
+			}
+			n, err := io.CopyN(bw, br, r.End-r.Start+1)
+			pos = r.Start + n
+			if err != nil {
+				break
+			}
+			bw.WriteByte('\n')
+		}
+		return bw.Flush()
+	}
+	line := int64(1)
+	ri := 0
+	for ri < len(rs) {
+		chunk, err := br.ReadSlice('\n')
+		if len(chunk) > 0 {
+			if line >= rs[ri].Start {
+				if _, werr := bw.Write(chunk); werr != nil {
+					return werr
+				}
+			}
+			if err == nil {
+				if line >= rs[ri].End {
+					ri++
+				}
+				line++
+			}
+		}
+		if err == bufio.ErrBufferFull {
+			continue // a long line: the rest of it comes next
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return bw.Flush()
+}
+
+// selectRanges resolves a line, group or kind selector to sorted, merged
+// ranges and their unit.
+func selectRanges(ix *Index, sel string) ([]Range, string, error) {
+	if m := lineSel.FindStringSubmatch(sel); m != nil {
+		a, _ := strconv.ParseInt(m[1], 10, 64)
+		b := a
+		if m[2] != "" {
+			b, _ = strconv.ParseInt(m[2], 10, 64)
+		}
+		if a < 1 || b < a || b > ix.Lines {
+			return nil, "", inputError("line range " + sel + " is outside the input, which has " + plural(ix.Lines, "line", "lines"))
+		}
+		return []Range{{a, b}}, "lines", nil
+	}
+	var rs []Range
+	if m := groupSel.FindStringSubmatch(sel); m != nil {
+		i, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[1])
+		if i < 0 || i >= len(ix.Groups) {
+			return nil, "", inputError("no group " + sel + "; this input has " + plural(int64(len(ix.Groups)), "group", "groups"))
+		}
+		rs = mergeRanges(groupRanges(ix.Groups[i]))
+	} else if _, ok := ParseKind(sel); ok || sel == "keep" {
+		for _, g := range ix.Groups {
+			if (sel == "keep" && g.Kept) || g.Kind == sel {
+				rs = append(rs, groupRanges(g)...)
+			}
+		}
+		rs = mergeRanges(rs)
+	} else {
+		return nil, "", inputError("unknown selector " + quote(sel) + "; use " + selectors)
+	}
+	unit := "lines"
+	if ix.Unit == "bytes" {
+		unit = "bytes"
+	}
+	return rs, unit, nil
+}
+
 // extractBytes copies byte ranges (inclusive) out of data, one per line.
 func extractBytes(data []byte, rs []Range) []byte {
 	var out bytes.Buffer

+package abbreviatory
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"strconv"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// The streaming expand gives the same bytes as Expand, for every selector
+// of every fixture.
+func TestExpandToMatchesExpand(t *testing.T) {
+	checked := 0
+	for name, data := range fixtures(t) {
+		res, err := Reduce(bytes.NewReader(data), Options{Budget: 4096})
+		if err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		sels := []string{"", "fail", "error", "warn", "info", "pass", "skip", "keep", "L1", "L1-3", "L" + strconv.FormatInt(res.InputLines, 10)}
+		if res.InputLines > 10 {
+			sels = append(sels, "L5-"+strconv.FormatInt(res.InputLines-2, 10))
+		}
+		for i := range res.Index.Groups {
+			sels = append(sels, "g"+strconv.Itoa(i))
+		}
+		if res.Format == "json" {
+			sels = append(sels, "errors", "/items/3", "/items/2/name")
+		}
+		for _, sel := range sels {
+			want, werr := Expand(data, res.Index, sel)
+			var got bytes.Buffer
+			gerr := ExpandTo(&got, bytes.NewReader(data), res.Index, sel)
+			if (werr == nil) != (gerr == nil) {
+				t.Fatalf("%s %q: Expand error %v, ExpandTo error %v", name, sel, werr, gerr)
+			}
+			if werr == nil && !bytes.Equal(want, got.Bytes()) {
+				t.Fatalf("%s %q: %d bytes from Expand, %d from ExpandTo", name, sel, len(want), got.Len())
+			}
+			checked++
+		}
+	}
+	for _, sel := range []string{"g999999", "L0", "nonsense"} {
+		var b bytes.Buffer
+		ix := &Index{Lines: 3, Groups: []IndexGroup{}}
+		if err := ExpandTo(&b, bytes.NewReader([]byte("a\nb\nc\n")), ix, sel); err == nil || b.Len() != 0 {
+			t.Fatalf("%q: error %v, wrote %d bytes", sel, err, b.Len())
+		}
+	}
+	// Lines longer than the read buffer, and a last line with no newline.
+	long := bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), 200<<10)
+	data := append(append(append([]byte("one\n"), long...), '\n'), []byte("three")...)
+	ix := &Index{Lines: 3, Unit: "lines"}
+	for _, sel := range []string{"L2", "L2-3", "L3", "L1-3"} {
+		want, _ := Expand(data, ix, sel)
+		var got bytes.Buffer
+		ExpandTo(&got, bytes.NewReader(data), ix, sel)
+		if !bytes.Equal(want, got.Bytes()) {
+			t.Fatalf("long lines %q: %d vs %d bytes", sel, len(want), got.Len())
+		}
+	}
+	t.Logf("%d selectors checked", checked)
+}

+#!/bin/sh
+# Copyright Abbreviatory.com 2026
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+#
+# Builds the browser demo into a site checkout: the engine compiled to
+# WebAssembly, Go's loader for it, the page (demo/index.html) and samples
+# from the test fixtures. The site serves it at /demo/.
+#
+#   sh scripts/build-demo.sh SITE_DIR
+#
+# SITE_DIR is a checkout of the abbreviatory.com site; the demo goes to
+# SITE_DIR/static/demo/. Needs Go and Python 3.
+set -eu
+site=${1:?usage: build-demo.sh SITE_DIR}
+cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
+out="$site/static/demo"
+rm -rf "$out"
+mkdir -p "$out/samples"
+
+GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w' -o "$out/abbreviatory.wasm" ./cmd/abbreviatory-wasm
+goroot=$(go env GOROOT)
+if test -f "$goroot/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js"; then

+    # serve: the HTTP service gives the same report as the command line.
+    path = FIXTURES / "gotest-json.txt"
+    want = run([exe, "reduce", "-store", store, path]).stdout.decode().replace("\r\n", "\n")
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([str(exe), "serve", "-addr", "127.0.0.1:0", "-store", store, "-token", "smoke"],
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+    try:
+        line = proc.stderr.readline()
+        found = re.search(r"http://\S+", line)
+        require(found, f"serve printed {line!r}")
+        base = found.group(0)
+        import urllib.request
+        def call(method, url, body=None, accept=None):
+            req = urllib.request.Request(base + url, data=body, method=method, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer smoke"})
+            if accept:
+                req.add_header("Accept", accept)
+            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
+                return resp.read()
+        health = json.loads(call("GET", "/healthz"))
+        require(health["version"] == source_version(), f"healthz: {health}")
+        got = call("POST", "/reduce", path.read_bytes(), "text/plain").decode()
+        require(got == want, "serve and reduce give different reports")
+        res = json.loads(call("POST", "/reduce?budget=1024", path.read_bytes()))
+        whole = call("GET", "/expand/" + res["ref"])
+        require(whole == path.read_bytes(), "serve's whole-input reference doesn't give the file back")
+        try:
+            urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/reduce", data=b"x", timeout=60)
+            require(False, "serve answered without the token")
+        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
+            require(e.code == 401, f"without the token: {e.code}")
+    finally:
+        proc.terminate()
+        proc.wait(timeout=30)
+    checks += 1
+
+    # mcp: an agent's session over standard input and output.
+    msgs = [
+        {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize", "params": {"protocolVersion": "2025-06-18", "capabilities": {}, "clientInfo": {"name": "smoke", "version": "1"}}},
+        {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"},
+        {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/list"},
+        {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 3, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "reduce", "arguments": {"path": str(path)}}},
+    ]
+    r = run([exe, "mcp", "-store", store], stdin="".join(json.dumps(m) + "\n" for m in msgs).encode())
+    answers = {m["id"]: m for m in (json.loads(l) for l in r.stdout.decode().splitlines() if l.strip())}
+    require(answers[1]["result"]["serverInfo"]["version"] == source_version(), f"mcp initialize: {answers.get(1)}")
+    require([t["name"] for t in answers[2]["result"]["tools"]] == ["reduce", "run", "expand", "history"], f"mcp tools: {answers.get(2)}")
+    require(answers[3]["result"]["content"][0]["text"].replace("\r\n", "\n") == want, "mcp and reduce give different reports")
+    checks += 1
+

 }
 
+// ExpandTo writes the part of a stored original that a reference names to
+// w, streaming it from the store: memory stays small however large the
+// original is (a JSON pointer still reads its document whole). A bad
+// reference is reported before anything is written.
+func (s *Store) ExpandTo(w io.Writer, ref string) error {
+	id, sel, err := abbreviatory.ParseRef(ref)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	ixData, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id, ".idx.json"))
+	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	var ix abbreviatory.Index
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(ixData, &ix); err != nil {
+		return errors.New("store: damaged index for " + id + ": " + err.Error())
+	}
+	f, err := os.Open(s.path(id, ".gz"))
+	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	defer f.Close()
+	gz, err := gzip.NewReader(f)
+	if err != nil {
+		return errors.New("store: damaged original for " + id + ": " + err.Error())
+	}
+	now := time.Now()
+	os.Chtimes(s.path(id, ".gz"), now, now)
+	return abbreviatory.ExpandTo(w, gz, &ix, sel)
+}
+
 // Expand loads a reference's original and returns the part it names.

 	id, sel, err := abbreviatory.ParseRef(ref)

 	data, ix, err := s.Load(id)
 	if err != nil {
-		return nil, errors.New(id + ": " + err.Error())
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, err)
 	}
 	return abbreviatory.Expand(data, ix, sel)
 }
